ann.t: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates — Senco Gold Limited has informed the Exchange about Earning Call Transcript pertaining to Q1 FY27 - Financial Results.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Senco Gold Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates — Senco Gold Limited has informed the Exchange about Earnings Call Transcript for Q4 FY26 - Financial Results
Appointment — Senco Gold Limited has informed the Exchange regarding re-appointment of  M/s L.B. Jha & Co. LLP, Chartered Accountants. as internal auditor of the company for the FY 2026-2027
Resignation — Senco Gold Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr. Dhaval Jeetendra Raja as Senior Management Personnel of the company w.e.f. April 10, 2026.
Allotment of Securities — Senco Gold Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 88340 securities pursuant to ESOP/ESPS at its meeting held on March 10, 2026
Outcome of Board Meeting — Senco Gold Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025.

Copy of Newspaper Publication — Senco Gold Limited has informed the Exchange about publication of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2025.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Senco Gold Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2025.
